frames.label: Map_Sonic_0602
frames.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Draw ONE original 16-bit pixel sprite of MICA the jade pangolin on transparent background. Image 1 is this frame's stock native pose: match its exact stride phase, limb/boot positions, rotation, framing and silhouette size, redrawing all anatomy as MICA; never recolour Sonic. Image 2 is MICA concept (jade form). Images 3/4 are approved flat WALK and RUN style anchors. MICA: rounded overlapping jade pangolin scales, small round ears, long tapered scaled tail, cream muzzle/belly, white gloves, coral hiking boots with tan lug soles. No Sonic spines, ears, face or shoes. Frame walk-inverted-00: 135-degree inverted slope, head lower-left and feet upper-right. Keep the native rotated pose, do NOT turn upright. Keep the native support/lift legs distinct and match the extended boot angles precisely. New drawing consistent with the flat pilot, compact crisp pixel clusters, dark native one-pixel outline, restrained scale highlights. One character only; no ground, shadow, text, grid or extra frames.

Head correction prompt:
Edit this ORIGINAL MICA pangolin pixel sprite to match its native pose reference. Input 1 is MICA drawing; input 2 is the native 8x pose guide; input 3 MICA concept; input 4 approved flat pixel style. Change only the head orientation and neck join. MICA's muzzle, nose and gaze must point UPPER RIGHT, toward 1 o'clock, exactly as the native reference's face. Current face points left/down incorrectly. Keep head on the left of the hips, and keep the legs and boots on the right in their exact current stride/rotation, including coral speed arcs if present. Preserve the full body orientation, framing, silhouette size, tail, glove positions, palette/style, overlapping round jade pangolin scales, white gloves, coral hiking boots, small round ears. Only turn the head within its existing place to look upward/right toward travel direction. Do not rotate or stand the body upright. No hedgehog spines, no Sonic face or shoes. Transparent background; one sprite; no ground, labels or added elements. Frame walk-inverted-00.
frames.reduction: largest alpha component; Lanczos to existing box; fixed palette indices; inside outline; support normalization (at most 10% shrink around unchanged hotspot or transparent right padding)
